messages:
maria_partners: Quick check-in for the catalog listing tomorrow. Need final signoff on: (1) quiet/embargo window, (2) SI dry-run timing, (3) HW partner certification slot confirmations, (4) final landing copy.
josh_eng: API surface stabilized last night. One minor header mismatch with the partner SDK; pushing patch to staging now.
talia_mktg: Copy update: hero CTA variants ready. Want final quote and one-sentence product line from eng by 10:00 PT to lock the blog.
ravi_legal: Embargo ok for Tue 08:00 PT. Reminder: partner logos need signed usage form. I'll drop the form into the shared drive and add a short checklist.
sam_si: Dry-run request: Wed 13:30 PT for a 45-minute session. Need partner devs added to staging org and scoped tokens. Also request a one-page troubleshooting cheat sheet for the common 401/429 cases.
maria_partners: Ill schedule the dry-run and invite HW partner leads. @josh_eng can you confirm token provisioning flow?
josh_eng: Token example (partner-qa): POST /tokens with body {role:partner, scopes:["catalog:read","deploy:exec"], ttl:86400}. Will share a curl in the doc channel.
talia_mktg: CDN purge plan: purge-on-deploy. If catalog goes live at 08:00 PT we should purge at 08:05 PT. OK?
ravi_legal: Fine with purge timing. Also: no named customer quotes in launch blog; generic customer language only.
sam_si: Noted. We'll keep sample workloads synthetic. Can we get perf numbers (p95/p99, batch=4) for the sample image generation route?
josh_eng: Sharing a one-slide perf summary by EOD. p95 ~ 120ms, p99 ~ 240ms on staging with batch=4.
deploybot: Release scheduled: marketplace-catalog v2.0 -> production window 2024-07-09T08:00:00Z. Watch #release-war-room.
maria_partners: Action items: 1) @ravi_legal upload logo form + embargo note (AM). 2) @josh_eng share token curl + perf slide (EOD). 3) @sam_si draft SI cheat sheet + confirm attendees (today). 4) @talia_mktg lock hero + blog once eng quote in (10:00 PT). I'll send consolidated partner playbook after these close. Any blockers?
